fields.title: Title
fields.promptPlaceholder: Review dependencies and report anything outdated or vulnerable.
fields.modelPlaceholder: Leave empty for the provider default
fields.enabledHint: Paused tasks keep their schedule but do not run.
fields.conflictPolicyHint: What to do when this task is due while its previous run is still going. Queue keeps one pending trigger; Replace aborts the current run.
fields.tagsHint: Comma-separated labels for grouping and filtering.
fields.commandHint: The command runs with sh -c in the project directory before the agent. Its stdout must be JSON: {"prompt": "..."} runs the agent with that prompt, {"skip": true, "reason": "..."} skips the run, {"skip": false} keeps the task prompt. A non-zero exit or invalid JSON fails the run without calling the agent. Leave empty to run the agent directly.

params.title: Parameters (optional)
params.hint: Each parameter is exported to the run environment as SCHEDULED_TASK_PARAM_<NAME>, plus SCHEDULED_TASK_PARAMS as compact JSON. Leave the default empty for a value that must be supplied when running.
params.name: Name
params.requiredNoDefault: Required parameters must be supplied at run time.

builtins.title: Predefined variables (always available)
builtins.hint: Every run exports these to both the script gate and the agent session. Read them from the environment instead of hardcoding paths.
builtins.ID: Scheduled task id (stable across runs — not a chat session id)
builtins.TITLE: Task name
builtins.PROJECT: Project root that owns the task
builtins.DIR: Task root directory — the task owns it and organizes it however it wants
builtins.RUN_DIR: This run's directory (run.json, prompt.md, output.md, logs/)
builtins.PARAMS: All resolved parameter values as compact JSON
